defects.what: head/origin/aheadBehind are literals ('c847319...', '0 0'), not read from git. Re-running the script at HEAD 8451ead still emits head c847319.
defects.impact: none on the numbers; but the report field named `head` is not the head at run time, so a future reader cannot tell when the run happened from it. It should be `headAtWrite` or computed.

overall.reason: None of the fail conditions fires: it is not a gate (exit 0 always, exit 2 only for unreadable input, not referenced by any other script), it does not red any gate, it does not soften the threshold (keeps 1.0, rejects 1.2 and 0.8 with reasons, marks critical), and it does not rewrite an existing verdict (r5t4 untouched, criterion2Literal still PASS, overall no-go preserved, freeze list declared observational).
